title: Actual cyclic carriers with a winding-independent original-metric bound

input_scope.parameter: Nonempty compact connected metric P, based at u0.
input_scope.family: The given original map-and-inverse continuous Q-centralizer family fixes pi^-1(X), where X is compact and contains pi(x).
input_scope.band: Actual embedded annulus or Mobius band disjoint from X, with infinite-order original core deck element.
input_scope.evaluation_domain: h_u(v) lies on the specified original lifted core L; lambda(u) is its unique real coordinate.
input_scope.countable_assembly: Pairwise disjoint actual bands, with chosen quotient points escaping every compact set and all actual core-evaluation equations retained.

proved_maps: Original band-cover map and inverse, exact component stabilizer and Q-translate decomposition.
Long-range shear and inverse for both normal-orientation signs.
Short-range two-piece interval maps and inverses in disjoint actual disk carriers.
Based family correction H=G^-1 h with inverse h^-1 G.
Countable disjoint-band uniform paste with the explicit inverse limit.
proved_bounds: Long-range correction displacement <=4a(pi v)+2epsilon, independent of winding range.
With epsilon=(eta(pi v)-a(pi v))/2, both correction displacements <4eta(pi v).
Corrected-family distance <=B+omega_P^-(B), with the original compact-family inverse modulus.
Disjoint-band product tail <=8sup_tail eta for maps plus inverses.
Corrected-family tail <=4sup_tail eta+omega_P^-(4sup_tail eta), retaining the same original inverse modulus.
nonorientable_scope: Mobius monodromy (t,b)->(t+1,-b) is retained explicitly; beta is even.
remaining_tasks: A controlled transformation of arbitrary actual point tracks to the specified core-line evaluation domain.
Compatible crossing carriers, remaining edges and cycles, and the global cutoff for arbitrary original families.
